confirmEmail.linkOpened: Enter the password you chose when you registered. If you did not register, or no longer know that password, register again.

resetPassword.recoveryInvalid: Recovery link is invalid or expired.

setup.title: Set up an authenticator app

setup.qrLabel: QR code to add {account} to an authenticator app
setup.typeKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.explain: If you lose your authenticator app, each of these codes confirms it's you once. They are shown only now: keep them somewhere safe.

replace.explain: Enter a code to create new recovery codes. Your old recovery codes stop working.

remove.explain: Enter a code to remove the authenticator app. Pages that ask for a code won't open until you set one up again.
